newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Jan 15-16 diesel/jet from BB Energy.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Jan 15-16 diesel/jet from BB Energy.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender 185,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel from western trader BB Energy, a company source said on Friday.

The 1.0-percent sulhpur diesel was purchased at a premium of $1.57 per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, while the jet fuel was bought at a $1.77 per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo between January 15-16, he said.

In its last tender, CPC bought the same volume of diesel and jet fuel from Kuwait-based Independent Petroleum Group at a premium of 69 cents per barrel and at 99 cents per barrel premium for jet fuel, both overt Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis for January 9-10 delivery.
